sources: ASEAN Secretariat (GMAC unofficial translation of MLVT Prakas No. 196 KB/Kr.K)
Prakas No. 196 on Use of Foreign Workforce (20 August 2014)

facts.c: MLVT generally allows foreign workers up to 10% of a company's Cambodian workforce.
facts.q: Vocational Training, in general, will permit the use of foreign workforce not exceeding 10% of the

facts.c: Within the 10% cap, non-specialised foreign employees or workers are limited to 1% of the Cambodian workforce (office staff 3%, specialised 6%).
facts.q: - Non-specialized employee or worker : 1 per cent

facts.c: Employers must send next year's request for foreign workers to MLVT by the end of November each year.
facts.q: Vocational Training by the end of November of each year.

facts.c: Employers may recruit foreigners only as specialists, technicians or skilled workers for posts Cambodians cannot fill, with MLVT's written permission in advance.
facts.q: enterprise/establishment may recruit foreigners who are specialists, technicians or professionally

facts.c: The work permit fee is the one set in Joint Prakas No. 335/20 between MLVT and the Ministry of Economy and Finance.
facts.q: Pay the work permit fee as stated in the Joint Prakas between the MLVT and the Ministry of Economy and Finance (Joint Prakas No.335/20)

facts.c: A Joint Foreign Workforce Inspection Team (JFWIT) inspects companies' work permits and employment cards.
facts.q: Cambodia established a Joint Foreign Workforce Inspection Team (JFWIT) to inspect companies’ compliance with the labour legislation.
